value.rationale: The complete parameter classification answers a natural decision question: when can the unrestricted globally optimal two-period incentive induce unstable feedback, even though an equally optimal stable incentive exists exactly at a sharp private-cost boundary? The sign and discontinuity regimes, exact stable/unstable rational example, normalized value-slope jump, and critical cubic-root law are motivated by sensitivity of fixed-contract design to private cost. They are more informative than routine quartic stationary roots or numerical evidence and identify a concrete robustness boundary for the minimal nontrivial horizon.
